Dynamics.name: Dynamics
Dynamics.documentation: Dynamics of the electric car. VehicleModes is the state machine every scenario moves through. Each interaction is one use case drawn as a sequence: an actor asks, a controller decides, actuators act, and the driver gets an acknowledgement (dashed «reply» message). Lifelines carry the names of the logical parts, so the sequences and the logical architecture read as one model. Each interaction states the mode it starts in and the mode it ends in.

Dynamics::VehicleModes.name: VehicleModes
Dynamics::VehicleModes.documentation: Modes of the car. Locked is the resting state. Unlocked lets occupants in. Ready means the immobilizer is released and high voltage is on. Driving means a gear other than park is selected. Parked is Ready with park selected. Charging is Unlocked with a charger connected.

Dynamics::UnlockSequence.name: UnlockSequence
Dynamics::UnlockSequence.documentation: Precondition Locked. Postcondition Unlocked. The driver presses unlock on the key fob. The vehicle controller authenticates the credential, the body controller releases the latches and flashes the indicators, and the cabin wakes. The immobilizer stays armed.

Dynamics::UnlockDeniedSequence.name: UnlockDeniedSequence
Dynamics::UnlockDeniedSequence.documentation: Precondition Locked. Postcondition Locked. Alternative to Unlock: the credential does not match. The vehicle controller refuses, the latches stay engaged and the driver sees no indicator flash.

Dynamics::LockSequence.name: LockSequence
Dynamics::LockSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Locked. The driver presses lock on the key fob. The vehicle controller authenticates, the body controller checks that every door is closed, engages the latches and flashes the indicators as confirmation.

Dynamics::OpenDoorSequence.name: OpenDoorSequence
Dynamics::OpenDoorSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Unlocked. An occupant pulls the handle. The body controller confirms the car is unlocked, releases that door's latch and raises the door-ajar warning on the cluster.

Dynamics::CloseDoorSequence.name: CloseDoorSequence
Dynamics::CloseDoorSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Unlocked. An occupant pushes the door shut. The latch engages, the body controller clears the door-ajar warning and the cluster stops showing it.

Dynamics::OpenWindowSequence.name: OpenWindowSequence
Dynamics::OpenWindowSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Unlocked. An occupant holds the window switch down. The body controller drives the lift motor from battery power until the switch is released or the window is fully open.

Dynamics::CloseWindowSequence.name: CloseWindowSequence
Dynamics::CloseWindowSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Unlocked. An occupant holds the window switch up. The body controller raises the window and watches the motor current; a pinch reverses the glass before it closes.

Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequence.name: AdjustClimateSequence
Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequence.documentation: Precondition Ready. Postcondition Ready. The driver sets a temperature. The climate system asks the battery for power, drives heater, compressor and fans, and the cluster shows the set point.

Dynamics::PlayMediaSequence.name: PlayMediaSequence
Dynamics::PlayMediaSequence.documentation: Precondition Ready. Postcondition Ready. A passenger selects a title. The entertainment system checks the cabin is awake, draws power, starts playback and shows now playing.

Dynamics::ChargeSequence.name: ChargeSequence
Dynamics::ChargeSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Charging. The driver plugs in. The charge inlet detects the plug, the battery negotiates a session with the charger, the vehicle controller locks the plug and inhibits driving, and the cluster shows the state of charge.

Dynamics::EndChargeSequence.name: EndChargeSequence
Dynamics::EndChargeSequence.documentation: Precondition Charging. Postcondition Unlocked. The driver presses unlock to end the session. The battery stops the session with the charger, the vehicle controller releases the plug lock and the cluster shows the final state of charge.

Dynamics::StartVehicleSequence.name: StartVehicleSequence
Dynamics::StartVehicleSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Ready. The driver holds the brake and presses start. The vehicle controller re-checks the key, releases the immobilizer, closes the high-voltage contactor and shows Ready once the drive controller reports it is live.

Dynamics::StopVehicleSequence.name: StopVehicleSequence
Dynamics::StopVehicleSequence.documentation: Precondition Parked. Postcondition Unlocked. With park selected the driver presses start again. The vehicle controller disables the drive controller, opens the high-voltage contactor, re-arms the immobilizer and the cluster goes dark.

Dynamics::ChangeGearSequence.name: ChangeGearSequence
Dynamics::ChangeGearSequence.documentation: Precondition Ready. Postcondition Driving. The driver moves the gear stick. The drive controller checks the car is standing still with the brake pressed, sets the motor mode and reports the gear to the cluster.

Dynamics::AccelerateSequence.name: AccelerateSequence
Dynamics::AccelerateSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver presses the accelerator. The drive controller turns pedal travel into a torque command bounded by the battery's discharge limit, the engine draws power and drives the wheels, and the cluster shows speed.

Dynamics::BrakeSequence.name: BrakeSequence
Dynamics::BrakeSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver presses the brake pedal. The drive controller lights the brake lamps, blends regenerative torque on the motor with friction pressure on the calipers, and the wheels slow.

Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequence.name: EmergencyStopSequence
Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver brakes hard from speed. Extends Brake: the drive controller commands maximum deceleration, modulates the calipers against wheel lock and the body controller switches the hazard lights on.

Dynamics::TurnLeftSequence.name: TurnLeftSequence
Dynamics::TurnLeftSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver turns the steering wheel left. The drive controller scales the angle with vehicle speed, commands the wheel angle and the body controller flashes the left indicator.

Dynamics::TurnRightSequence.name: TurnRightSequence
Dynamics::TurnRightSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver turns the steering wheel right. Same path as TurnLeft with the opposite angle and the right indicator.

Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequence.name: CleanWindshieldSequence
Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Driving. The driver pulls the wiper stalk. The body controller sets a wipe rate from vehicle speed, pulses the washer, the wipers sweep the glass and report when they have parked.

Dynamics::ToggleHeadlightsSequence.name: ToggleHeadlightsSequence
Dynamics::ToggleHeadlightsSequence.documentation: Precondition Ready. Postcondition Ready. The driver turns the light switch. The body controller draws power, lights the headlamps and the cluster shows the beam symbol.

Dynamics::ParkSequence.name: ParkSequence
Dynamics::ParkSequence.documentation: Precondition Driving. Postcondition Parked. The driver stops, holds the brake and selects park. The drive controller confirms the car is standing still, sets park, locks the parking pawl through the friction brakes and the cluster shows P.

Dynamics::DriveSequence.name: DriveSequence
Dynamics::DriveSequence.documentation: Precondition Unlocked. Postcondition Parked. The journey as one scenario: start, select drive, accelerate, steer, brake and park. The detailed sequences for each step are the included use cases; this one shows the hand-overs between the controllers.

Dynamics::VehicleModesView.documentation: Modes of the car and the use cases that move it between them.

Functions.name: Functions
Functions.documentation: Functional architecture of the electric car. Each top-level part is a function the car performs for its users; the parts nested inside it are the functional entities the function decomposes into. A dashed «keyword» dependency points from the function that needs another function to the function it depends on. Security and Charging are roots: driving, comfort and visibility depend on an authenticated vehicle and on energy. Every functional entity is allocated to exactly one logical part, and a logical part comprises one or more entities. That allocation is how the logical architecture is synthesized from the use cases.

Functions::Security.name: Security
Functions::Security.documentation: Authenticate the driver, unlock and lock the doors, and release the immobilizer. Every driving function depends on Security before the car will move.

Functions::Security::authenticate.name: authenticate
Functions::Security::authenticate.documentation: Check the key fob credential before any unlock, lock or start. Allocated to the vehicle controller.

Functions::Security::immobilizer.name: immobilizer
Functions::Security::immobilizer.documentation: Keep propulsion inhibited until the driver is authenticated and the start button is pressed. Allocated to the vehicle controller.

Functions::Security::wakeUp.name: wakeUp
Functions::Security::wakeUp.documentation: Bring the cabin systems out of sleep when the car unlocks. Allocated to the vehicle controller.

Functions::Security::lockControl.name: lockControl
Functions::Security::lockControl.documentation: Engage and release the latches and flash the indicators as confirmation. Allocated to the body controller.

Functions::Security::driverInformation.name: driverInformation
Functions::Security::driverInformation.documentation: Tell the driver what state the car is in: ready, gear, speed, charge and warnings. Allocated to the instrument cluster.

Functions::Charging.name: Charging
Functions::Charging.documentation: Take energy from a home or fast charger and store it in the battery. Speed control, climate, entertainment, lighting and windshield cleaning draw on this energy.

Functions::Charging::chargeConnection.name: chargeConnection
Functions::Charging::chargeConnection.documentation: Detect the plug and carry the charger's energy into the car. Allocated to the charge inlet.

Functions::Charging::chargeSession.name: chargeSession
Functions::Charging::chargeSession.documentation: Negotiate current with the charger and stop at the target state of charge. Allocated to the battery.

Functions::Charging::energyStorage.name: energyStorage
Functions::Charging::energyStorage.documentation: Store traction energy and publish the discharge limit. Allocated to the battery.

Functions::SpeedControl.name: SpeedControl
Functions::SpeedControl.documentation: Command traction torque and braking, including regenerative braking, so the driver can set and hold speed. Depends on Security for the immobilizer and on Charging for energy.

Functions::SpeedControl::torqueArbitrati.name: torqueArbitration
Functions::SpeedControl::torqueArbitrati.documentation: Turn pedal travel into a torque command bounded by the battery limit. Allocated to the drive controller.

Functions::SpeedControl::regenBlending.name: regenBlending
Functions::SpeedControl::regenBlending.documentation: Split a deceleration request between regenerative torque and friction pressure. Allocated to the drive controller.

Functions::SpeedControl::tractionDrive.name: tractionDrive
Functions::SpeedControl::tractionDrive.documentation: Convert electrical power into torque at the wheels. Allocated to the engine.

Functions::SpeedControl::frictionBraking.name: frictionBraking
Functions::SpeedControl::frictionBraking.documentation: Apply hydraulic brake pressure, with anti-lock modulation in an emergency stop. Allocated to the friction brakes.

Functions::Maneuvrability.name: Maneuvrability
Functions::Maneuvrability.documentation: Steer the car left and right, select the direction of travel, and keep it directionally stable. Depends on Security, and on SpeedControl because steering response changes with speed.

Functions::Maneuvrability::steeringContr.name: steeringControl
Functions::Maneuvrability::steeringContr.documentation: Turn the steering wheel angle into a wheel angle. Allocated to the drive controller.

Functions::Maneuvrability::gearSelection.name: gearSelection
Functions::Maneuvrability::gearSelection.documentation: Accept park, reverse, neutral or drive only when it is safe. Allocated to the drive controller.

Functions::Maneuvrability::roadHolding.name: roadHolding
Functions::Maneuvrability::roadHolding.documentation: Keep the tyres on the road over bumps and in corners. Allocated to the suspension.

Functions::Entertainment.name: Entertainment
Functions::Entertainment.documentation: Play audio and video for the driver and passengers. Depends on Security so the cabin systems wake only for an authorized user, and on Charging for power.

Functions::Entertainment::mediaPlayback.name: mediaPlayback
Functions::Entertainment::mediaPlayback.documentation: Select and play titles on the cabin display and speakers. Allocated to the entertainment system.

Functions::Climate.name: Climate
Functions::Climate.documentation: Heat, cool and demist the cabin. Depends on Charging because the compressor and heater are electric.

Functions::Climate::cabinTemperature.name: cabinTemperature
Functions::Climate::cabinTemperature.documentation: Hold the cabin at the set temperature with heater, compressor and fans. Allocated to the climate system.

Functions::WindshieldCleaning.name: WindshieldCleaning
Functions::WindshieldCleaning.documentation: Wipe and wash the windshield so the driver can see. Depends on Charging for the wiper motor and on SpeedControl so the wipe rate can follow vehicle speed.

Functions::WindshieldCleaning::wipeContr.name: wipeControl
Functions::WindshieldCleaning::wipeContr.documentation: Turn the stalk position into wipe speed and washer pulses. Allocated to the body controller.

Functions::WindshieldCleaning::wipeSweep.name: wipeSweep
Functions::WindshieldCleaning::wipeSweep.documentation: Sweep the glass and park the blades. Allocated to the wipers.

Functions::Lighting.name: Lighting
Functions::Lighting.documentation: Headlamps, tail lamps, brake lamps and direction indicators. Depends on Security and Charging. Indicators also depend on Maneuvrability because they follow the intended turn.

Functions::Lighting::headlampControl.name: headlampControl
Functions::Lighting::headlampControl.documentation: Switch low and high beam on and off. Allocated to the body controller.

Functions::Lighting::indicatorControl.name: indicatorControl
Functions::Lighting::indicatorControl.documentation: Flash direction indicators, brake lamps and hazard lights. Allocated to the body controller.

Functions::Lighting::lampDrive.name: lampDrive
Functions::Lighting::lampDrive.documentation: Light the lamp units. Allocated to the lamps.

Functions::FunctionsView.name: FunctionsView
Functions::FunctionsView.documentation: Functional dependency view. Arrows are «Authorize», «Energy», «Stability», «Speed» and «Indicate» dependencies between functions. Allocations are filtered out; see FunctionAllocationView.

Functions::FunctionAllocationView.name: FunctionAllocationView
Functions::FunctionAllocationView.documentation: Functional entities and the logical parts they are allocated to. One logical part comprises one or more entities.

LogicalArchitecture.name: LogicalArchitecture
LogicalArchitecture.documentation: Logical architecture of the electric car. Car is the assembly. Parts are logical, not yet software, electronics or metal. Three controllers decide: vehicleController owns power modes and authentication, driveController owns torque, braking, gear and steering, bodyController owns locks, doors, windows, lamps and wipers. Driver controls talk to a controller, controllers talk to actuators, and the instrument cluster tells the driver what happened. Dependencies show what commands what, what supplies energy and what is mounted on what. Interfaces name the contracts: a provider port (Out) and a consumer port (In), joined by a connection. The physical architecture realizes these parts with «implements».

LogicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.name: DirectionCommand
LogicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.documentation: Steering command. The steering wheel provides the driver's angle to the drive controller, which provides the wheel angle to the road wheels.

LogicalArchitecture::GearCommand.name: GearCommand
LogicalArchitecture::GearCommand.documentation: Park, reverse, neutral or drive. The gear stick provides it to the drive controller, which provides the motor mode to the engine.

LogicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.name: TorqueRequest
LogicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.documentation: Requested traction torque from pedal travel. The accelerator provides it and the drive controller consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::TorqueCommand.name: TorqueCommand
LogicalArchitecture::TorqueCommand.documentation: Arbitrated traction torque, positive for drive and negative for regeneration. The drive controller provides it and the engine consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.name: BrakeRequest
LogicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.documentation: Requested deceleration from pedal force. The brake pedal provides it and the drive controller consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::BrakeCommand.name: BrakeCommand
LogicalArchitecture::BrakeCommand.documentation: Friction brake pressure after regen blending. The drive controller provides it and the friction brakes consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::StartRequest.name: StartRequest
LogicalArchitecture::StartRequest.documentation: Start or stop the vehicle. The start button provides it and the vehicle controller consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::Credential.name: Credential
LogicalArchitecture::Credential.documentation: Driver credential. The key fob provides it and the vehicle controller consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::DriveEnable.name: DriveEnable
LogicalArchitecture::DriveEnable.documentation: Immobilizer release and high-voltage ready. The vehicle controller provides it and the drive controller consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::LockCommand.name: LockCommand
LogicalArchitecture::LockCommand.documentation: Engage or release the door latches. The body controller provides it and the locks consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::DoorCommand.name: DoorCommand
LogicalArchitecture::DoorCommand.documentation: Open or close a door. The body controller provides it and the doors consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::WindowCommand.name: WindowCommand
LogicalArchitecture::WindowCommand.documentation: Raise or lower a window. The body controller provides it and the window lifts consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::LampCommand.name: LampCommand
LogicalArchitecture::LampCommand.documentation: Headlamps, brake lamps, indicators and hazard lights. The body controller provides it and the lamps consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::WipeCommand.name: WipeCommand
LogicalArchitecture::WipeCommand.documentation: Wipe and wash. The body controller provides it and the wipers consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::DriverFeedback.name: DriverFeedback
LogicalArchitecture::DriverFeedback.documentation: Everything the driver is told: ready, gear, speed, state of charge, warnings. The vehicle controller provides it and the instrument cluster consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.name: EnergySupply
LogicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.documentation: Traction energy. The battery provides it. The motor, climate, entertainment, lamps and window lifts consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.name: ChargeFeed
LogicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.documentation: Energy from an external charger. The charge inlet provides it and the battery consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.name: WindshieldClear
LogicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.documentation: Wiping action. The wipers provide it and the windshield consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::Car.name: Car
LogicalArchitecture::Car.documentation: Logical electric car: driver controls, three controllers, traction, energy, body and cabin systems.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::keyFob.name: keyFob
LogicalArchitecture::Car::keyFob.documentation: Remote key the driver carries. Provides Credential to the vehicle controller for unlock, lock and start.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::startButton.name: startButton
LogicalArchitecture::Car::startButton.documentation: Driver control that starts and stops the vehicle. Provides StartRequest to the vehicle controller.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::steeringWheel.name: steeringWheel
LogicalArchitecture::Car::steeringWheel.documentation: Driver control for direction. Provides DirectionCommand to the drive controller.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::gearStick.name: gearStick
LogicalArchitecture::Car::gearStick.documentation: Driver control for park, reverse, neutral and drive. Provides GearCommand to the drive controller.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::acceleratorPed.name: acceleratorPedal
LogicalArchitecture::Car::acceleratorPed.documentation: Driver control for requested traction torque. Provides TorqueRequest to the drive controller.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::brakePedal.name: brakePedal
LogicalArchitecture::Car::brakePedal.documentation: Driver control for deceleration. Provides BrakeRequest to the drive controller.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::vehicleControl.name: vehicleController
LogicalArchitecture::Car::vehicleControl.documentation: Decides whether the car is Locked, Unlocked, Ready, Driving, Parked or Charging. Authenticates the key fob, releases the immobilizer, enables the drive controller and tells the driver through the instrument cluster.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::driveControlle.name: driveController
LogicalArchitecture::Car::driveControlle.documentation: Turns pedal, gear and steering inputs into torque, brake pressure, motor mode and wheel angle. Blends regenerative and friction braking. Only acts when the vehicle controller has enabled driving.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::bodyController.name: bodyController
LogicalArchitecture::Car::bodyController.documentation: Commands the body actuators: locks, doors, window lifts, lamps and wipers. Flashes the indicators to confirm lock and unlock.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::instrumentClus.name: instrumentCluster
LogicalArchitecture::Car::instrumentClus.documentation: Display and chimes in front of the driver. Consumes DriverFeedback and shows ready state, gear, speed, state of charge and warnings.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::climateSystem.name: climateSystem
LogicalArchitecture::Car::climateSystem.documentation: Logical heating, ventilation and cooling of the cabin. Consumes EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::entertainmentS.name: entertainmentSystem
LogicalArchitecture::Car::entertainmentS.documentation: Logical cabin audio and video. Consumes EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::engine.name: engine
LogicalArchitecture::Car::engine.documentation: Electric traction motor, nominally 150 kW. Consumes GearCommand and TorqueCommand from the drive controller and EnergySupply from the battery. Drives the wheels.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::battery.name: battery
LogicalArchitecture::Car::battery.documentation: Traction battery, nominally 60 kWh. Provides EnergySupply and consumes ChargeFeed. Its discharge limit bounds the torque the drive controller may command.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::chargeInlet.name: chargeInlet
LogicalArchitecture::Car::chargeInlet.documentation: Inlet where a home or DC charger connects. Provides ChargeFeed to the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::chassis.name: chassis
LogicalArchitecture::Car::chassis.documentation: Structural backbone. The motor, battery, suspension and body are mounted on it.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::wheels.name: wheels
LogicalArchitecture::Car::wheels.documentation: Road wheels that accelerate, brake and steer the car. Consume DirectionCommand from the drive controller; the engine and the friction brakes act on them.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::frictionBrakes.name: frictionBrakes
LogicalArchitecture::Car::frictionBrakes.documentation: Hydraulic friction brakes on every wheel. Consume BrakeCommand from the drive controller and act on the wheels.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::suspension.name: suspension
LogicalArchitecture::Car::suspension.documentation: Links the wheels to the chassis and keeps the tyres on the road.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::body.name: body
LogicalArchitecture::Car::body.documentation: Body shell (kaross). Sets length, width, height, seating and cargo volume, and forms the occupant cell.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::doors.name: doors
LogicalArchitecture::Car::doors.documentation: Four doors in the body shell. Consume DoorCommand from the body controller and report open or closed.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::windows.name: windows
LogicalArchitecture::Car::windows.documentation: Side and rear glazing in the body shell.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::windowLifts.name: windowLifts
LogicalArchitecture::Car::windowLifts.documentation: Motors that raise and lower the side windows. Consume WindowCommand from the body controller and EnergySupply from the battery. Stop on pinch.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::windshield.name: windshield
LogicalArchitecture::Car::windshield.documentation: Front glass. Consumes WindshieldClear from the wipers.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::wipers.name: wipers
LogicalArchitecture::Car::wipers.documentation: Wiper and washer mechanism on the body. Consumes WipeCommand from the body controller and provides WindshieldClear to the windshield.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::locks.name: locks
LogicalArchitecture::Car::locks.documentation: Door latches. Consume LockCommand from the body controller and report latched or released.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::lamps.name: lamps
LogicalArchitecture::Car::lamps.documentation: Headlamps, tail lamps, brake lamps, direction indicators and hazard lights. Consume LampCommand from the body controller and EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalView.name: CarLogicalView
LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalView.documentation: Logical whitebox of Car: nested parts, ports and connections between them (dependencies filtered out).

LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalDependenc.name: CarLogicalDependenciesView
LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalDependenc.documentation: Logical car parts and their «Command», «Enable», «Inform», «Energy», «Mount», «Support», «Actuate» and «Clear» dependencies (connections filtered out).

LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalTree.name: CarLogicalTree
LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalTree.documentation: Containment tree of the logical car.

PhysicalArchitecture.name: PhysicalArchitecture
PhysicalArchitecture.documentation: Physical architecture of the electric car. Software components run on embedded controllers. The three logical controllers each get their own computer: vehicleEcu, driveEcu and bodyEcu. Climate and entertainment share the infotainment computer. The engine and the battery each have their own. Everything else is mechanical. Every physical part has an «implements» dependency to the logical part it realizes. The same interface contracts as the logical architecture are realized here: a provider port (Out) and a consumer port (In) on the physical parts that play those roles. Logical counterparts live in LogicalCounterparts so the physical whitebox stays clean.

PhysicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.name: DirectionCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.documentation: Steering command, same contract as the logical architecture. Steering wheel to drive computer, drive computer to wheels.

PhysicalArchitecture::GearCommand.name: GearCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::GearCommand.documentation: Gear selection, same contract as the logical architecture. Gear selector to drive computer, drive computer to engine computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.name: TorqueRequest
PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.documentation: Torque request, same contract as the logical architecture. The accelerator provides it and the drive computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueCommand.name: TorqueCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueCommand.documentation: Arbitrated torque, same contract as the logical architecture. The drive computer provides it and the engine computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.name: BrakeRequest
PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.documentation: Brake request, same contract as the logical architecture. The brake pedal provides it and the drive computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeCommand.name: BrakeCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeCommand.documentation: Friction brake pressure, same contract as the logical architecture. The drive computer provides it and the brake calipers consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::StartRequest.name: StartRequest
PhysicalArchitecture::StartRequest.documentation: Start or stop, same contract as the logical architecture. The start button provides it and the vehicle computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::Credential.name: Credential
PhysicalArchitecture::Credential.documentation: Driver credential, same contract as the logical architecture. The key fob provides it and the vehicle computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::DriveEnable.name: DriveEnable
PhysicalArchitecture::DriveEnable.documentation: Immobilizer release, same contract as the logical architecture. The vehicle computer provides it and the drive computer consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::LockCommand.name: LockCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::LockCommand.documentation: Latch command, same contract as the logical architecture. The body computer provides it and the door locks consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::DoorCommand.name: DoorCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::DoorCommand.documentation: Door command, same contract as the logical architecture. The body computer provides it and the door assembly consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::WindowCommand.name: WindowCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::WindowCommand.documentation: Window command, same contract as the logical architecture. The body computer provides it and the window lift assembly consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::LampCommand.name: LampCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::LampCommand.documentation: Lamp command, same contract as the logical architecture. The body computer provides it and the lamp units consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::WipeCommand.name: WipeCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::WipeCommand.documentation: Wipe command, same contract as the logical architecture. The body computer provides it and the wiper assembly consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::DriverFeedback.name: DriverFeedback
PhysicalArchitecture::DriverFeedback.documentation: Driver feedback, same contract as the logical architecture. The vehicle computer provides it and the instrument cluster unit consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.name: EnergySupply
PhysicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.documentation: Traction energy, same contract as the logical architecture. The battery controller provides it. The motor, climate hardware, display, lamps and window lifts consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.name: ChargeFeed
PhysicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.documentation: External charge energy, same contract as the logical architecture. The charge inlet provides it and the battery controller consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.name: WindshieldClear
PhysicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.documentation: Wiping action, same contract as the logical architecture. The wiper assembly provides it and the windshield consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: LogicalCounterparts
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical architecture counterparts referenced by «implements» from VehiclePhysical. Kept outside the physical whitebox so PhysicalView stays mechanical/software only.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: car
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical Car. The whole physical car implements this assembly.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: keyFob
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical key fob, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: startButton
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical start button, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: steeringWheel
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical steering wheel, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: gearStick
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical gear stick, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: acceleratorPedal
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical accelerator pedal, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: brakePedal
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical brake pedal, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: vehicleController
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical vehicle controller, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: driveController
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical drive controller, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: bodyController
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical body controller, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: instrumentCluster
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical instrument cluster, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: climateSystem
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical climate system, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: entertainmentSystem
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical entertainment system, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: engine
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical engine (traction motor), from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: battery
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical battery, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: chassis
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical chassis, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: wheels
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical wheels, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: frictionBrakes
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical friction brakes, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: suspension
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical suspension, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: doors
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical doors, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: windows
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical windows, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: windowLifts
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical window lifts, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: body
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical body shell (kaross), from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: windshield
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical windshield, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: wipers
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical wipers, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: locks

PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.name: lamps
PhysicalArchitecture::LogicalCounterpart.documentation: Logical lamps, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical.name: VehiclePhysical
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical.documentation: Physical car: embedded controllers with their software, and the mechanical parts. Implements the logical Car.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::v.name: vehicleEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::v.documentation: Embedded computer for power modes, authentication and the immobilizer. Implements the logical vehicle controller. Proxy ports expose Credential, StartRequest, DriveEnable and DriverFeedback at the ECU boundary.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::v.name: vehicleControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::v.documentation: Software component for vehicle modes, key authentication and driver feedback. Hosted on the vehicle computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: driveEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Embedded computer for torque, braking, gear and steering. Implements the logical drive controller. Proxy ports expose the driver inputs and the actuator commands at the ECU boundary.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: driveControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Software component for torque arbitration, regen blending, gear mode and steering angle. Hosted on the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: bodyEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Embedded computer for locks, doors, windows, lamps and wipers. Implements the logical body controller. Proxy ports expose the body commands at the ECU boundary.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: bodyControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Software component for lock, door, window, lamp and wiper control. Hosted on the body computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: infotainmentEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Embedded computer shared by the entertainment software and the climate software. Implements the logical entertainment system and the logical climate system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: entertainmentSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Software component for the cabin audio and video. Hosted on the infotainment computer. Implements the logical entertainment system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: climateControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Software component for cabin heating, cooling and airflow. Hosted on the infotainment computer, together with entertainment. Implements the logical climate system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: engineEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Embedded computer for the traction motor. Separate module. Implements the logical engine. Proxy ports expose GearCommand and TorqueCommand at the ECU boundary.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: engineControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Software component for motor torque and mode. Consumes GearCommand and TorqueCommand from the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Embedded computer for the traction battery and charging. Separate module. Implements the logical battery. Proxy ports expose EnergySupply and ChargeFeed at the ECU boundary.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Software component for battery limits and charge sessions. Provides EnergySupply and consumes ChargeFeed.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::k.name: keyFobUnit
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::k.documentation: Radio key fob. Provides Credential to the vehicle computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: startButtonMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Push button on the dashboard. Provides StartRequest to the vehicle computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: steeringWheelMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Mechanical steering wheel with angle sensor. Provides DirectionCommand to the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.name: gearStickMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.documentation: Mechanical gear selector for park, reverse, neutral and drive. Provides GearCommand to the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::a.name: acceleratorPedalMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::a.documentation: Mechanical accelerator pedal with travel sensor. Provides TorqueRequest to the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: brakePedalMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Mechanical brake pedal with force sensor. Provides BrakeRequest to the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: instrumentClusterUnit
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Display and sounder behind the steering wheel. Consumes DriverFeedback.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::h.name: hvacAssembly
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::h.documentation: Mechanical climate hardware: heater, compressor, fans and ducts. Consumes EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: displayAndSpeakers
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Mechanical and electronic cabin display and speakers. Consumes EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: electricMotor
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Mechanical traction motor. Consumes EnergySupply. The engine computer commands it.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryPack
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Mechanical battery pack. Implements the logical battery. The battery computer manages it.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chassisFrame
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Mechanical chassis frame. Implements the logical chassis.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wheelSet
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Mechanical road wheels with steering knuckles. Consume DirectionCommand from the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: brakeCaliperAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Hydraulic calipers, discs and the brake actuator. Consume BrakeCommand from the drive computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: suspensionAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Mechanical suspension. Implements the logical suspension.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: doorAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Door shells, hinges and position sensors. Consume DoorCommand from the body computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: windowAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Side and rear glass panes. Implements the logical windows.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: windowLiftAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Window lift motors with pinch sensing. Consume WindowCommand from the body computer and EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: bodyShell
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Mechanical body shell (kaross). Implements the logical body.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wiperAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Mechanical wiper and washer. Consumes WipeCommand from the body computer and provides WindshieldClear.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: doorLockAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Mechanical door latches with lock motors. Consume LockCommand from the body computer.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.name: lampUnits
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.documentation: Mechanical lamp units. Consume LampCommand from the body computer and EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chargeInletMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Mechanical charge inlet socket. Provides ChargeFeed to the battery controller.

PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalView.name: PhysicalView
PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalView.documentation: Physical whitebox. Software nested in its computer, mechanical parts beside them, provider and consumer ports with their connections. Climate and entertainment share infotainmentEcu.

PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalDependenci.name: PhysicalDependenciesView
PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalDependenci.documentation: Physical parts and their «implements» dependencies to LogicalCounterparts (connections filtered out).

PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalTree.name: PhysicalTree
PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalTree.documentation: Containment tree of the physical car, including software hosted on each computer.

Requirements.name: Requirements
Requirements.documentation: Stakeholder requirements and user stories for a compact battery-electric passenger car. Size, performance, safety, security and comfort are the requirement groups. Driving, charging and parking are told as user stories. Leaf requirements refine a group. Logical parts satisfy the leaves.

Requirements::Size.name: Size
Requirements::Size.documentation: The car shall fit a compact passenger-car envelope and carry people and luggage.

Requirements::VehicleLength.name: VehicleLength
Requirements::VehicleLength.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 4.5 m long.

Requirements::VehicleWidth.name: VehicleWidth
Requirements::VehicleWidth.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 1.85 m wide, excluding mirrors.

Requirements::VehicleHeight.name: VehicleHeight
Requirements::VehicleHeight.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 1.6 m high.

Requirements::PassengerCapacity.name: PassengerCapacity
Requirements::PassengerCapacity.documentation: The vehicle shall seat at least four occupants.

Requirements::CargoVolume.name: CargoVolume
Requirements::CargoVolume.documentation: The vehicle shall provide at least 300 litres of cargo volume behind the rear seats.

Requirements::Performance.name: Performance
Requirements::Performance.documentation: The car shall deliver everyday range, acceleration, speed and charging.

Requirements::Range.name: Range
Requirements::Range.documentation: The vehicle shall travel at least 350 km on a full charge in the WLTP cycle.

Requirements::Acceleration.name: Acceleration
Requirements::Acceleration.documentation: The vehicle shall accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in at most 8 seconds.

Requirements::TopSpeed.name: TopSpeed
Requirements::TopSpeed.documentation: The vehicle shall be capable of at least 160 km/h.

Requirements::ChargeTime.name: ChargeTime
Requirements::ChargeTime.documentation: The battery shall charge from 10 percent to 80 percent in at most 30 minutes on DC fast charge.

Requirements::PropulsionModes.name: PropulsionModes
Requirements::PropulsionModes.documentation: The driver shall be able to select park, reverse, neutral and drive.

Requirements::PowerModes.name: PowerModes
Requirements::PowerModes.documentation: The driver shall make the vehicle ready to drive, and shut it down, with a single control.

Requirements::Safety.name: Safety
Requirements::Safety.documentation: The car shall protect occupants and people outside the vehicle.

Requirements::CrashProtection.name: CrashProtection
Requirements::CrashProtection.documentation: The occupant cell shall remain intact in the applicable frontal and side impact tests.

Requirements::BrakingDistance.name: BrakingDistance
Requirements::BrakingDistance.documentation: The vehicle shall stop from 100 km/h within 40 m on dry pavement.

Requirements::PedestrianProtection.name: PedestrianProtection
Requirements::PedestrianProtection.documentation: The front structure shall reduce pedestrian leg and head injury in a frontal impact.

Requirements::OccupantRestraint.name: OccupantRestraint
Requirements::OccupantRestraint.documentation: Every seating position shall have a seat belt and be covered by an airbag.

Requirements::DirectionalControl.name: DirectionalControl
Requirements::DirectionalControl.documentation: The vehicle shall follow the steering angle commanded by the driver.

Requirements::ForwardVisibility.name: ForwardVisibility
Requirements::ForwardVisibility.documentation: The driver shall be able to clear the windshield while driving.

Requirements::NightVisibility.name: NightVisibility
Requirements::NightVisibility.documentation: The driver shall be able to light the road ahead with low and high beam.

Requirements::Comfort.name: Comfort
Requirements::Comfort.documentation: The car shall let occupants get in and out easily and keep the cabin comfortable.

Requirements::CabinAccess.name: CabinAccess
Requirements::CabinAccess.documentation: Occupants shall be able to open and close every door and side window from inside the cabin.

Requirements::CabinClimate.name: CabinClimate
Requirements::CabinClimate.documentation: Occupants shall be able to set the cabin temperature between 16 and 28 degrees Celsius.

Requirements::CabinMedia.name: CabinMedia
Requirements::CabinMedia.documentation: Occupants shall be able to play audio and video on the cabin system.

Requirements::Security.name: Security
Requirements::Security.documentation: The car shall unlock, lock and immobilize only for an authenticated driver.

Requirements::AccessControl.name: AccessControl
Requirements::AccessControl.documentation: Doors shall unlock only after the driver credential has been authenticated.

Requirements::Immobilizer.name: Immobilizer
Requirements::Immobilizer.documentation: Propulsion shall stay inhibited until the driver has been authenticated.

Requirements::LockIndication.name: LockIndication
Requirements::LockIndication.documentation: The driver shall receive a confirmation when the vehicle is locked.

Requirements::DriveToDestination.name: DriveToDestination
Requirements::DriveToDestination.documentation: As a driver I want to drive from origin to destination so that I can travel on battery power alone.

Requirements::ControlSpeed.name: ControlSpeed
Requirements::ControlSpeed.documentation: As a driver I want to accelerate and brake smoothly so that I stay comfortable in traffic.

Requirements::FollowTheRoad.name: FollowTheRoad
Requirements::FollowTheRoad.documentation: As a driver I want to turn left and right so that I can follow the road.

Requirements::ChargeAtHome.name: ChargeAtHome
Requirements::ChargeAtHome.documentation: As a driver I want to charge overnight at home so that the car is ready in the morning.

Requirements::ChargeAway.name: ChargeAway
Requirements::ChargeAway.documentation: As a driver I want to fast-charge during a trip so that I can continue when the battery is low.

Requirements::ParkAndLeave.name: ParkAndLeave
Requirements::ParkAndLeave.documentation: As a driver I want to park, select park and lock the car so that it stays where I left it.

Requirements::EnjoyTheCabin.name: EnjoyTheCabin
Requirements::EnjoyTheCabin.documentation: As a passenger I want climate and entertainment during the trip so that the journey stays comfortable.

Requirements::DriveAtNight.name: DriveAtNight
Requirements::DriveAtNight.documentation: As a driver I want to light the road so that I can drive after dark.

Requirements::EnterAndExit.name: EnterAndExit
Requirements::EnterAndExit.documentation: As a passenger I want to open the doors and windows so that I can get in, get out and let air in.

Requirements::RequirementsGraphView.name: RequirementsGraphView
Requirements::RequirementsGraphView.documentation: Requirement graph. Group requirements, leaf requirements and user stories, with «refine» dependencies.

Requirements::RequirementsTableView.name: RequirementsTableView
Requirements::RequirementsTableView.documentation: Requirement table. Flat list or hierarchy following «refine» links. User stories carry Type UserStory.

UseCases.name: UseCases
UseCases.documentation: Use cases for the electric car, split into Driving (what the driver does on the road) and Managing (what driver and passengers do with the car when it stands still). Actors are the driver, the passenger and the external charger. Drive includes starting the car and the manoeuvres it is made of. Park includes stopping and locking. EmergencyStop extends Brake. Each use case names the requirement it pursues and the user story it refines.

UseCases::ElectricCar.name: ElectricCar
UseCases::ElectricCar.documentation: The battery-electric passenger car that is the subject of these use cases.

UseCases::Driving.name: Driving
UseCases::Driving.documentation: Use cases performed from the driver's seat with the car Ready or Driving: start and stop, gear, speed, steering, visibility and parking.

UseCases::Driving::StartVehicle.name: StartVehicle
UseCases::Driving::StartVehicle.documentation: The driver presses the start button with the brake held. The car authenticates the key, releases the immobilizer, closes the high-voltage contactor and shows Ready.

UseCases::Driving::StopVehicle.name: StopVehicle
UseCases::Driving::StopVehicle.documentation: With the car in Park the driver presses the start button again. The car opens the high-voltage contactor, re-arms the immobilizer and shows Off.

UseCases::Driving::ChangeGear.name: ChangeGear
UseCases::Driving::ChangeGear.documentation: The driver selects park, reverse, neutral or drive. The drive controller only accepts the change when it is safe and shows the gear.

UseCases::Driving::TurnLeft.name: TurnLeft
UseCases::Driving::TurnLeft.documentation: The driver turns the steering wheel left and the car follows.

UseCases::Driving::TurnRight.name: TurnRight
UseCases::Driving::TurnRight.documentation: The driver turns the steering wheel right and the car follows.

UseCases::Driving::Brake.name: Brake
UseCases::Driving::Brake.documentation: The driver presses the brake pedal and the car slows, blending regeneration and friction, with the brake lamps lit.

UseCases::Driving::Accelerate.name: Accelerate
UseCases::Driving::Accelerate.documentation: The driver presses the accelerator and the motor delivers torque within the battery's limit.

UseCases::Driving::EmergencyStop.name: EmergencyStop
UseCases::Driving::EmergencyStop.documentation: The driver brakes hard from speed. Extends Brake with maximum deceleration, anti-lock modulation and hazard lights.

UseCases::Driving::CleanWindshield.name: CleanWindshield
UseCases::Driving::CleanWindshield.documentation: The driver starts the wipers and washer and the windshield is cleared.

UseCases::Driving::ToggleHeadlights.name: ToggleHeadlights
UseCases::Driving::ToggleHeadlights.documentation: The driver switches the headlamps on or off, or between low and high beam.

UseCases::Driving::Drive.name: Drive
UseCases::Driving::Drive.documentation: The driver takes the car from origin to destination. Includes starting, gear selection, speed control and steering. The passenger rides along.

UseCases::Driving::Park.name: Park
UseCases::Driving::Park.documentation: The driver stops, selects park, shuts the car down and locks it. Includes StopVehicle and Lock.

UseCases::Managing.name: Managing
UseCases::Managing.documentation: Use cases performed with the car standing still: access, doors and windows, cabin comfort, media and charging. Driver and passenger share most of them.

UseCases::Managing::Unlock.name: Unlock
UseCases::Managing::Unlock.documentation: The driver presses unlock on the key fob. The car authenticates the credential, releases the latches, flashes the indicators and wakes the cabin.

UseCases::Managing::Lock.name: Lock
UseCases::Managing::Lock.documentation: The driver presses lock on the key fob. The car checks that all doors are closed, engages the latches and flashes the indicators as confirmation.

UseCases::Managing::OpenDoor.name: OpenDoor
UseCases::Managing::OpenDoor.documentation: An occupant pulls a door handle on an unlocked car and the door releases.

UseCases::Managing::CloseDoor.name: CloseDoor
UseCases::Managing::CloseDoor.documentation: An occupant closes a door; the latch engages and the door-ajar warning clears.

UseCases::Managing::OpenWindow.name: OpenWindow
UseCases::Managing::OpenWindow.documentation: An occupant presses the window switch down and the window lowers.

UseCases::Managing::CloseWindow.name: CloseWindow
UseCases::Managing::CloseWindow.documentation: An occupant presses the window switch up and the window rises, stopping if it pinches.

UseCases::Managing::AdjustClimate.name: AdjustClimate
UseCases::Managing::AdjustClimate.documentation: The driver or a passenger sets cabin temperature and airflow.

UseCases::Managing::PlayMedia.name: PlayMedia
UseCases::Managing::PlayMedia.documentation: The driver or a passenger plays audio or video on the cabin system.

UseCases::Managing::Charge.name: Charge
UseCases::Managing::Charge.documentation: The driver connects a home or fast charger. The car and the charger negotiate a session, the battery takes energy and the state of charge is reported until the driver unplugs.

UseCases::VehicleUseCaseView.name: VehicleUseCaseView
UseCases::VehicleUseCaseView.documentation: Use-case diagram. Driver, passenger and charger are associated with the cases they take part in. «include» and «extend» relate the cases. Driving cases on one side, Managing cases on the other.
